questions.question: Which statement best defines a project stakeholder?
options: Only someone who finances the project
An individual, group, or organization that may affect or be affected by the project
Only a member of the project team
Anyone who supports the project, excluding opponents
questions.answer: An individual, group, or organization that may affect or be affected by the project

questions.question: What information does a stakeholder register contain?
options: Project costs, deadlines, and technical specifications
Only stakeholder names and telephone numbers
Identification information, assessment information, and stakeholder classification
Only stakeholder complaints and suggested solutions
questions.answer: Identification information, assessment information, and stakeholder classification

questions.question: A stakeholder knows about the project but neither supports nor resists it. What is their engagement level?
options: Unaware
Resistant
Supportive
Neutral

questions.question: Which activity belongs to managing stakeholder engagement?
options: Communicating with stakeholders and resolving their issues
Recording only the project’s financial transactions
Avoiding stakeholders who oppose the project
Postponing communication until project completion
questions.answer: Communicating with stakeholders and resolving their issues

questions.question: What is the main purpose of controlling stakeholder engagement?
options: Replacing stakeholders who disagree with project decisions
Preventing changes to the stakeholder management plan
Monitoring stakeholder relationships and adjusting engagement strategies
Ensuring all stakeholders have identical expectations
questions.answer: Monitoring stakeholder relationships and adjusting engagement strategies

questions.question: Stakeholder management is only critical during the initiation phase of a project.
Why is regular dialogue and prompt issue resolution with stakeholders critical for a project manager?
options: It helps ensure overall stakeholder satisfaction throughout the project's life.
It guarantees that the project budget will never be exceeded.
It eliminates the need for a Project Charter.
It prevents stakeholders from asking questions during execution.
questions.answer: It helps ensure overall stakeholder satisfaction throughout the project's life.

questions.question: When identifying stakeholders, a project team must carefully consider and evaluate their:
options: Salary history and personal background
Needs, interests, and potential influence on the project
Technical coding abilities only
Availability to work full-time on the project team
questions.answer: Needs, interests, and potential influence on the project

questions.question: Which stakeholder engagement level describes someone who understands the project and its potential impacts, and actively helps it succeed?
options: Supportive
Leading
Neutral
Unaware

questions.question: A 'Resistant' stakeholder is someone who does not know about the project or its impact.
Which of the following is typically included in a Stakeholder Management Plan?
options: The actual source code for software deliverables
Stakeholders' current and desired engagement levels, relationships, and communication requirements
The daily timesheets of the support and admin staff
The finalized technical blueprints of the system architecture
questions.answer: Stakeholders' current and desired engagement levels, relationships, and communication requirements

questions.question: A comprehensive Stakeholder Management Plan should explain the methods for how the plan itself will be updated.
Beyond meeting scope, time, and cost goals, how else can project success be measured?
options: By ensuring the project team worked overtime every week
By keeping all stakeholders at a 'Neutral' engagement level
By satisfying the customer/sponsor, meeting quality expectations, and achieving ROI projections
By rejecting all change requests regardless of their value
questions.answer: By satisfying the customer/sponsor, meeting quality expectations, and achieving ROI projections
